limits: All numerical quantiles are descriptive empirical training tails, not certified 95% win probabilities.
Targets may have been saved after their historical feature dates; trainingInformationCutoff is the real maximum information cut, not a backdated training store.
New-date inputs precede artifact registration and are offline held-out observations, not a prospective trial.
Calendar labels lacking independent dates shrink to feature/pooled cells; no invented calendar multipliers.
Book price gate is a shadow screen only; no exchange fills, account capital path, or simulated profit is credited.
